_about: The Events page at /melbourne/events/ (engine/events_page.py). 'file' is the page's listing, written daily by fetch_happening.py next to the page; 'units' is the map's file the suburb filter and card outline come from. 'words' are the page's own text; the engine names no city or source. What's On Melbourne lists only events inside the City of Melbourne.

words.title: What’s on in Melbourne
words.intro: Every event in the City of Melbourne’s own What’s On listings for the next 30 days: festivals, markets, music, theatre, exhibitions, library programs, talks and more, in the CBD and the City’s suburbs.
words.listing: A listing, not a guide: the facts and a link to each event’s page on What’s On Melbourne, nothing else.
words.desc: What’s on in the City of Melbourne today, this weekend and over the next 30 days, from the City’s What’s On Melbourne listings, with free events marked.
words.card: Today, this weekend, the next 30 days
words.source: Events from What’s On Melbourne, © City of Melbourne, used for a non-commercial site.
